body:
All reviewer findings fixed. Build passes. Zero music refs in code files.

**Fixes completed:**

1. **Orphaned CSS refs removed:**
   - `src/pages/index.astro:22` — removed `grid-bg` class
   - `src/layouts/Layout.astro:85` — removed `noise-bg` class

2. **Dead file deleted:**
   - `src/components/Hero/HeroTitle.tsx` — no imports found, deleted

3. **Music references removed from 6 files:**
   - `src/pages/about/index.astro` — removed "Music Producer" from pageTitle/pageDescription, deleted YouTube link, replaced "Beyond Code (KenDaBeatmaker)" section with entrepreneurship-focused content, removed "music" from recent writing text
   - `src/pages/cv/index.astro` — removed "Lead Audio Engineer & Music Producer" experience entry, removed "Media Engineering" stack category (audio production, radio automation, signal processing), removed "Extensive background in professional audio production" from technical profile
   - `src/pages/blog/index.astro` — changed "music production" → "software" in pageDescription, removed "music" from essays text
   - `src/pages/rss.xml.ts` — changed "music production" → "software" in description
   - `src/lib/structured-data.ts` — removed "KenDaBeatmaker" from both alternateName arrays (ProfilePage + Person schema), changed "music production" → "software" in blog index schema description

**Verification:**
- ✅ Build passes (40 pages, 5.6s)
- ✅ Zero matches for `music|producer|beatmaker|youtube|kenda` in .tsx/.astro/.ts files (excluded .mdx blog content)
- ✅ HeroTitle.tsx confirmed deleted
- ✅ Typecheck: only pre-existing three.js type error (not caused by these changes)

Site now fully aligned with software engineer + entrepreneur positioning.
